This is a sentient, lawful neutral +21d20+2 greataxe (Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 10). It has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 120 feet. It communicates empathically by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or using it.

The DC for this property's saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the number of charges you expend.

messages.content:
Telekinesis
Legacy • 5th Level Transmutation (Cast at 5th Level)
Casting Time1 action
Durationup to 10 minutes
ComponentsV, S
Range60ft.
ConcentrationRequires Concentration
You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as your action each round for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell.
Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. Make an ability check with your spellcasting ability contested by the creature's Strength check. If you win the contest, you move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction, including upward but not beyond the range of this spell. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is restrained in your telekinetic grip. A creature lifted upward is suspended in mid-air.
On subsequent rounds, you can use your action to attempt to maintain your telekinetic grip on the creature by repeating the contest.
Object. You can try to move an object that weighs up to 1,000 pounds. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction, but not beyond the range of this spell.
If the object is worn or carried by a creature, you must make an ability check with your spellcasting ability contested by that creature's Strength check. If you succeed, you pull the object away from that creature and can move it up to 30 feet in any direction but not beyond the range of this spell.
You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

messages.speaker: Felicjan Janus Twardowski
messages.content:
Second Fiddle
Wondrous item, Rare
This seemingly ordinary wooden fiddle is surprisingly lightweight. Etched upon its back are swirling patterns that seem to shift and dance in the light. When you speak the command word, "Capriccio", the bow begins to move on its own accord, playing a lively tune as the fiddle floats gently in the air beside you. While active, the Second Fiddle floats in the air and follows you, playing music that dynamically adapts to your actions. Tell a joke, and it might play a whimsical tune with a flourish at the punchline. Land a critical hit, and it will swell with a triumphant fanfare. Sneak past a guard, and it will soften to a barely audible whisper of sound.
As a reaction when you roll an ability check, a saving throw or an attack roll, you can focus on the music played by the Second Fiddle to inspire yourself. Roll a d6d6 and add the number rolled to the roll.
After getting inspired by the Second Fiddle two times, it looses its properties until the next dawn.

Starry Form: Archer
Range60ft.
2nd-level Circle of the Stars feature
As a bonus action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form, rather than transforming into a beast.
While in your starry form, you retain your game statistics, but your body becomes luminous; your joints glimmer like stars, and glowing lines connect them as on a star chart. This form sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The form lasts for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), are incapacitated, die, or use this feature again.
Whenever you assume your starry form, choose which of the following constellations glimmers on your body; your choice gives you certain benefits while in the form:
Archer. A constellation of an archer appears on you. When you activate this form, and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns while it lasts, you can make a ranged spell attack, hurling a luminous arrow that targets one creature within 60 feet of you. On a hit, the attack deals radiant damage equal to 1d81d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
Chalice. A constellation of a life-giving goblet appears on you. Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet of you can regain hit points equal to 1d81d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
Dragon. A constellation of a wise dragon appears on you. When you make an Intelligence or a Wisdom check or a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20d20 as a 10.

Scroll of Mass Sending
Scroll, Rare
This scroll has a line of instructions written along the top, but is otherwise left blank. The scroll has enough room for up to 250 words to be written on it. Reading from the scroll using an action duplicates the effects of the sending spell with the following changes: you can read up to 25 words aloud from the scroll on each of your turns. The birds are illusory. Each bird then immediately reappears before a different target to reiterate the message. You determine whether the birds use your voice or an altered one to repeat the message. If you use your voice, a creature recognizes you as the sender if it knows you. Otherwise, you remain anonymous as the sender. After repeating the message, the birds vanish.
When the spell ends, the scroll's magic is temporarily consumed. At dawn each day, the scroll regains its magical properties, becomes blank and can be used again.
